name: theme-material
title: Theme: Material
description: Material 3 Expressive palette and metrics as one more theme — tonal surfaces, capsule controls, circular corners, 8/10/10% state layers, press ripple, and expressive springs — installed into themes/material/ (theme.json, semantics.json, index.ts) for `selectTheme` to switch to while the app runs.
